title: Estate Pass-Through Discount Rates by Patronage — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) Schedule
content:
# Estate Pass-Through Discount Rates by Patronage

**Schedule — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital), later wholesale-supplier pass-through allocations an estate's claimant elects.**

The estate pass-through discount rate follows the member's patronage:

| The member's last final-billed service account | The capital account was opened | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| final billed in the allocation's own year or later | at least 180 full calendar months before the election | **5.0 percent** |
| final billed before the allocation's year | fewer than 180 full calendar months before the election | the patron class's early retirement discount rate, **7.5 percent** in every patron class |
| any other combination | | not set by this schedule |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The final-billed service account and its final date come from the deceased member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule records; the year of the final date is compared with the pass-through allocation year.
2. The account age is the full calendar months from the date the capital account was opened to the date of the election.
3. Both conditions of a row must hold together.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, 2022 pass-through allocation)

| Final date | Months since opening at the election | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 2022-06-30 | 180 | 5.0 percent |
| 2022-06-30 | 179 | not set by this schedule |
| 2021-11-15 | 179 | 7.5 percent |
| 2021-11-15 | 240 | not set by this schedule |
